ante jñāne@tra sopāye samastaḥ karmavistaraḥ / prasphuṭenaiva rūpeṇa bhāvī so@ntarbhaviṣyati kriyā hi nāma vijñānānnānyadvastu kramātmatām / upāyavaśataḥ prāptaṃ tatkriyeti puroditam samyagjñānaṃ ca muktyekakāraṇaṃ svaparasthitam / yato hi kalpanāmātraṃ svaparādivibhūtayaḥ tulye kālpanikatve ca yadaikyasphuraṇātmakaḥ / guruḥ sa tāvadekātmā siddho muktaśca bhaṇyate yāvānasya hi saṃtāno gurustāvatsa kīrtitaḥ / samyagjñānamayaśceti svātmanā mucyate tataḥ tata eva svasaṃtānaṃ jñānī tārayatītyadaḥ / yuktyāgamābhyāṃ saṃsiddhaṃ tāvāneko yato muniḥ tenātra ye codayanti nanu jñānādvimuktatā / dīkṣādikā kriyā ceyaṃ sā kathaṃ muktaye bhavet jñānātmā seti cejjñānaṃ yatrasthaṃ taṃ vimocayet / anyasya mocane vāpi bhavetkiṃ nāsamañjasam / iti te mūlataḥ kṣiptā yattvatrānyaiḥ samarthitam malo nāma kila dravyaṃ cakṣuḥsthapaṭalādivat / tadvihantrī kriyā dīkṣā tvañjanādikakarmavat tatpurastānniṣetsyāmo yuktyāgamavigarhitam / malamāyākarmaṇāṃ ca darśayiṣyāmahe sthitim

## tal-a01-p25

## tal-a01-p26

source_text: [and]-āmarśanīyadvairūpyānudghāṭanavaśātpunaḥ / saṃśayaḥ sa kimityaṃśe vikalpastvanyathā sphuṭaḥ tenānudghāṭitātmatvabhāvaprathanameva yat / prathamaṃ sa ihoddeśaḥ praśnaḥ saṃśaya eva ca tathānudghāṭitākārabhāvaprasaravartmanā / prasarantī svasaṃvittiḥ praṣṭrī śiṣyātmatāṃ gatā tathāntaraparāmarśaniścayātmatirohiteḥ / prasarānantarodbhūtasaṃhārodayabhāgapi yāvatyeva bhavedbāhyaprasare prasphuṭātmani / anunmīlitarūpā sā praṣṭrī tāvati bhaṇyate svayamevaṃ vibodhaśca tathā praśnottarātmakaḥ / guruśiṣyapade@pyeṣa dehabhedo hyatāttvikaḥ bodho hi bodharūpatvādantarnānākṛtīḥ sthitāḥ / bahirābhāsayatyeva drāksāmānyaviśeṣataḥ srakṣyamāṇaviśeṣāṃśākāṃkṣāyogyasya kasyacit / dharmasya sṛṣṭiḥ sāmānyasṛṣṭiḥ sā saṃśayātmikā srakṣyamāṇo viśeṣāṃśo yadā tūparamettadā / nirṇayo mātṛrucito nānyathā kalpakoṭibhiḥ tasyātha vastunaḥ svātmavīryākramaṇapāṭavāt / unmudraṇaṃ tayākṛtyā lakṣaṇottaranirṇayāḥ

## tal-a01-p27

source_text: [and]-nirṇītatāvaddharmāṃśapṛṣṭhapātitayā punaḥ / bhūyo bhūyaḥ samuddeśalakṣaṇātmaparīkṣaṇam dṛṣṭānumānaupamyāptavacanādiṣu sarvataḥ / uddeśalakṣaṇāvekṣātritayaṃ prāṇināṃ sphuret nirvikalpitamuddeśo vikalpo lakṣaṇaṃ punaḥ / parīkṣaṇaṃ tathādhyakṣe vikalpānāṃ paramparā nago@yamiti coddeśo dhūmitvādagnimāniti / lakṣyaṃ vyāptyādivijñānajālaṃ tvatra parīkṣaṇam uddeśo@yamiti prācyo gotulyo gavayābhidhaḥ / iti vā lakṣaṇaṃ śeṣaḥ parīkṣopamitau bhavet svaḥkāma īdṛguddeśo yajetetyasya lakṣaṇam / agniṣṭomādinetyeṣā parīkṣā śeṣavartinī vikalpasrakṣyamāṇānyarucitāṃśasahiṣṇunaḥ / vastuno yā tathātvena sṛṣṭiḥ soddeśasaṃjñitā tadaiva saṃviccinute yāvataḥ srakṣyamāṇatā / yato hyakālakalitā saṃdhatte sārvakālikam srakṣyamāṇasya yā sṛṣṭiḥ prāksṛṣṭāṃśasya saṃhṛtiḥ / anūdyamāne dharme sā saṃvillakṣaṇamucyate tatpṛṣṭhapātibhūyoṃśasṛṣṭisaṃhāraviśramāḥ / parīkṣā kathyate mātṛrucitā kalpitāvadhiḥ

parvabhedāstadviśeṣaścakracarcā tadarcanam / gurvādyantadinādyarcāprayojananirūpaṇam mṛteḥ parīkṣā yogīśīmelakādividhistathā / vyākhyāvidhiḥ śrutavidhirgurupūjāvidhistviyat naimittikaprakāśākhye @pyaṣṭāviṃśāhnike sthitam / adhikāryātmano bhedaḥ siddhapatnīkulakramaḥ arcāvidhirdautavidhī rahasyopaniṣatkramaḥ / dīkṣābhiṣekau bodhaścetyekonatriṃśa āhnike mantrasvarūpaṃ tadvīryamiti triṃśe nirūpitam / śūlābjabhedo vyomaśasvastikādinirūpaṇam vistareṇābhidhātavyamityekatriṃśa āhnike / guṇapradhānatābhedāḥ svarūpaṃ vīryacarcanam kalābheda iti proktaṃ mudrāṇāṃ saṃprakāśane / dvātriṃśatattvādīśākhyātprabhṛti prasphuṭo yataḥ na bhedo@sti tato noktamuddeśāntaramatra tat / mukhyatvena ca vedyatvādadhikārāntarakramaḥ ityuddeśavidhiḥ proktaḥ sukhasaṃgrahahetave / athāsya lakṣaṇāvekṣe nirūpyete yathākramam ātmā saṃvitprakāśasthitiranavayavā saṃvidityāttaśaktivrātaṃ tasya svarūpaṃ sa ca nija mahasaśchādanādbaddharūpaḥ / ātmajyotiḥsvabhāvaprakaṭanavidhinā tasya mokṣaḥ sa cāyaṃ citrākārasya citraḥ prakaṭita iha yatsaṃgraheṇārtha eṣaḥ
